sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Amendment Act 2016
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT III OF 2016
ACT III OF 2016
BALOCHISTAN PROHIBITION
OF EXPRESSING MATTERS ON WALLS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An
Act further to amend the Balochistan Prohibition of
Expressing Matters on Walls Ordinance 2001 (Ordinance No. LI of 2001)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary, 22nd February, 2016]
No. PAB/Legis:V(24)/2016/6017, dated
22.2.2016.---
The Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing Matters on
Walls (Amendment) Bill 2015, (Bill No.24 of 2015), having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 15th February,
2016 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on
17th February, 2016 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan
Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Balochistan
Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Ordinance 2001;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing
Matters on Walls (Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment in section 2, Ordinance LI of

the Balochistan Prohibition of Expressing Matters on
Walls Ordinance 2001 (Ordinance No. LI of 2001), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, in section 2, for the words, figure and commas fine not
exceeding Rs. 5,000/-, the words with comma fine which shall not be less than

3. Insertion of new section 2-A, Ordinance LI
of 2001.---In
the said Ordinance, after section 2, the following new section shall be
inserted, namely:-
2-A. Cognizance and summary trial.---(1) An offence under
this Ordinance shall be cognizable and not bailable.
(2) A Magistrate of the first class shall conduct the trial of
an offence under Balochistan Prohibition of
Expressing Matters on Walls Ordinance 2001 in accordance with the provisions of
Chapter XXII of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of 1898).
